'''XL-77''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] stationed at the [[Warehouse Aurek]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and worked for [[Hotho Allaran]].
